messages:
sara_pm: quick thread — big enterprise asked for: per-tenant audit buckets, BYOK per-tenant keys, SOC2 evidence export, and retention up to 7y. they want timeline + launch criteria by EOW
arnav_security: do we have a baseline for per-tenant key isolation? current plan was customer CMK per org via kms integration, not per-tenant. per-tenant raises keying surface and escrow concerns. :thinking_face:
maya_legal: 7y retention + cross-region replication triggers specific e-discovery and export constraints. need legal hold reversible snapshots and chain-of-custody. also need contractual language for key escrow and lawful intercept requests.
tina_eng: engineering constraints: per-tenant CMKs means ~N key objects per customer, more metadata in our keystore, and wider KMS API usage. also throughput impact for audit writes if we switch from aggregated audit stream to per-tenant buckets.
joe_ops: ops note — if we store audit artifacts in S3 per-tenant buckets we can leverage object lifecycle + replication rules. but S3 per-tenant buckets increases account limits and complicates provisioning. alternative: one bucket + tenant prefixes + per-tenant SSE-C/CMEK metadata. cheaper to manage but legal might prefer isolated buckets.
lucas_devex: SDK/Console changes: need UI for tenant-key onboarding, key health status, and an evidence export wizard. small UX MVP could be a CLI + signed-presigned-URL export endpoint.
sam_sales: customer wants this for a contract signing next month. they expect us to commit to BYOK + retention windows. can we provide a restricted beta for a single customer?
arnav_security: propose options: 1) MVP: per-tenant audit partitions with single-cmek-per-org (no per-tenant keys) + export playbook + legal hold flags. 2) Full: per-tenant CMKs + key escrow workflow + longer retention + per-tenant buckets. note: full needs manual review for compliance and KMS policy mapping.
sara_pm: timeline idea: opt1 (MVP) -> 6w to build (api + export + retention flags + acceptance tests). opt2 (Full) -> 14-18w with key escrow, infra changes, and legal ops. which is realistic?
tina_eng: opt1 realistic if we accept single CMK per org. we can reuse existing audit pipeline, add tenant tagging and retention TTL metadata. will need an infra spike for export performance and indexing. opt2 requires design doc + security review + KMS quota evaluation.
maya_legal: opt1 acceptance criteria: - legal hold snapshot API exists - export includes signed integrity manifest - retention policy configurable per org up to 7y with admin controls. opt2 adds a key escrow SLA and crypto proof of custody.
joe_ops: ops acceptance criteria: - automated provisioning for per-tenant prefixes/buckets - backup/restore tested for 7y data - DR runbook for tenant-level restores.
lucas_devex: devex acceptance criteria: - CLI/Console shows key health + retention config - export tool supports csv/json + manifest - audit log samples for QA.
sam_sales: can we offer opt1 as "beta" with an explicit limitation: no per-tenant CMK? customer likely signs if they get export + legal hold + 7y retention.
arnav_security: risk note: offering 7y retention without per-tenant CMK increases blast radius on key compromise. need to add mandatory KMS rotation + anomaly detection for audit ingestion.
sara_pm: decision proposal: ship opt1 as Beta to customer under a contract clause: "beta, single org CMK, no escrow". meanwhile start spec for opt2 and do feasibility research. agree? :eyes:
tina_eng: +1 for opt1 beta. will open design PR for the retention/partitioning changes and estimate tasks.
maya_legal: +1 with contingent contract language — legal will draft the addendum and escrow fallback language for opt2.
joe_ops: +1, ops will prepare provisioning templates and S3 lifecycle examples.
lucas_devex: +1, i'll mock the CLI flow and a minimal console panel for beta users.
sam_sales: +1, i'll align customer expectations and loop in account lead.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-partition-mvp -> canary window next Tue 02:00 UTC. (reaction :rocket:)
sara_pm: action items: - @tina_eng open PR + estimate (owner: tina) - @maya_legal draft contract addendum (owner: maya) - @joe_ops provisioning templates (owner: joe) - @lucas_devex beta CLI + console mock (owner: lucas) - @arnav_security run risk checklist and rotation policy (owner: arnav) - @sam_sales coordinate customer comms (owner: sam). Update thread with estimates by Thu.
arnav_security: quick sample retention config for API consumers:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acct-1234",
  "audit_retention_days": 2555,
  "legal_hold": false,
  "exportable": true
}
```
sara_pm: perfect — let's sync Thu 10:30am PT after estimates. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
